title: Beat Bloom
description: Hit the beat on a neon 3D highway to 32 songs: 20 originals, from lo-fi Rainy Window to 172 BPM Hyperloop, plus classics like Für Elise, Ode to Joy, Korobeiniki and Rondo alla Turca. Tap the lanes or use D F J K, hold long notes, chain combos and chase S ranks on Easy, Normal and Hard, or six lanes (S D F J K L) on Extreme. Earn stars to unlock new songs and climb the global leaderboard.
